## DELETE `/api/2.58/software`

**Tier:** T3  

Deletes a software package specified by software name and version. A software package being used for an installation can be deleted if the installation is `downloading`, `downloaded`, `aborted`, or `finished`. If the software package is currently `downloading`, the download will be cancelled.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | header | string |  | Access token (in JWT format) required to use any API endpoint (except `/oauth2`, `/login`, and `/logout`) |
| `X-Request-ID` | header | string |  | Supplied by client during request or generated by server. |

| `software_versions` | query | array of string |  | A comma-separated list of target software versions. |

**Responses:** `200` OK

## POST `/api/2.58/software-check`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)  

Creates a software check task. If there are no previously queued or running software check tasks, the new task immediately starts. Otherwise, it is queued and starts once all previously queued or running software check tasks finish. To create a task, use a software name and version.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | header | string |  | Access token (in JWT format) required to use any API endpoint (except `/oauth2`, `/login`, and `/logout`) |
| `X-Request-ID` | header | string |  | Supplied by client during request or generated by server. |
| `software_names` | query | array of string |  | A comma-separated list of software names. |
| `software_versions` | query | array of string |  | A comma-separated list of target software versions. |

**Responses:** `200` The software check record was created successfully. → `SoftwareChecksResponse`

## DELETE `/api/2.58/software-check`

**Tier:** T3  

Deletes a software check task specified by software name and version. The check task must be queued. If the check task is running or passed/failed then the task cannot be deleted.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | header | string |  | Access token (in JWT format) required to use any API endpoint (except `/oauth2`, `/login`, and `/logout`) |
| `X-Request-ID` | header | string |  | Supplied by client during request or generated by server. |
| `software_names` | query | array of string |  | A comma-separated list of software names. |
| `software_versions` | query | array of string |  | A comma-separated list of target software versions. |

**Responses:** `200` OK

## PATCH `/api/2.58/software-installations`

**Tier:** T2 (T3 if it destroys, eradicates, disables or overwrites)  

Modifies a software upgrade by continuing, retrying, or aborting it. All `override_checks` are updated before the command is issued if `add_override_checks` is present. The `override_checks` parameter is valid when `command` is set to `continue` or `retry`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | header | string |  | Access token (in JWT format) required to use any API endpoint (except `/oauth2`, `/login`, and `/logout`) |
| `X-Request-ID` | header | string |  | Supplied by client during request or generated by server. |
| `command` | query | string | yes | A user command that interacts with the upgrade. Commands may only be issued when the upgrade is paused. Valid values are `continue`, `retry`, and `abort`. The `continue` command continues a `paused` upgrade. The… |
| `current_step_id` | query | string | yes | The current step `id` of the installation. |

**Request body** (optional): `SoftwareInstallationPatch`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `add_override_checks` | array of `_override_check` | Adds the specified checks to the current list of override checks. |

**Responses:** `200` The `command` was issued and/or `override_checks` was… → `SoftwareInstallationsResponse`
